prompt: I seem to be the only user on our StackOne account. How do I add another person from my company to our organisation?
skill_note: Team management sits under Secure in the docs; the platform skill is the nearest owner.

fetch.name: fetches-manage-team-page
fetch.note: The page that documents inviting members and roles.

reference: Organisation Admins invite members from the organisation's Members settings.
There are two independent role layers: an organisation role (Admin or Member) and per-project roles assigned separately.
Organisation Admins see every project; Members only see the projects they are granted, directly or through a group.
